label: Qwen Image 2.1 Edit
description: Instruction editing via Qwen Image 2.1 (Qwen3-VL-8B encoder, 25 steps). Describe the change and refer to the source as <image1> (this stage has a single image socket, so @image_N mentions do not apply). Output size follows the input (keep it ≤ 2K). For several reference images use the Image stage's 'Qwen Image 2.1 Multi-Ref Edit'.

image.error: Image edit needs an upstream image — wire one into the stage's image input.

prompt.error: Describe the edit — e.g. 'change the background of <image1> to a light-gray studio backdrop, keep the subject unchanged'.
